source.title: Riparare SMART Disk Monitor per Samsung T7 / bridge ASMedia
source.objective: Eliminare il falso/ricorrente alert SMART su /dev/sdc (Samsung T7 Shield via USB NVMe ASMedia), ripristinare il monitoraggio SMART reale dopo disconnect/reconnect e mantenere notifiche solo quando azionabili.
source.acceptance_json: ["Il T7 Shield presente viene letto correttamente da smartd/smartctl attraverso il bridge ASMedia dopo reconnect o recovery.", "Nessun nuovo alert ricorrente 'unable/open() of NVMe device failed' quando il disco è presente e sano.", "La correzione è coperta da test mirati e integrata/deployata secondo il single-writer del repo fedora-system-monitor.", "Il runtime smartd e Fedora System Monitor risultano sani dopo il deploy e la verifica live."]
source.current_action: Source fix and targeted verification complete; live T7 validation and deployment await the physical drive.
source.next_action: Reconnect the T7 safely, then verify ASMedia SMART and deployed monitor.
source.blocker: Samsung T7 Shield is absent from current lsblk; physical SMART/reconnect acceptance cannot be verified despite merged PR #20.

work_item_result_receipts.summary: Source fix and targeted verification complete; live T7 validation and deployment await the physical drive.
work_item_result_receipts.remaining_json: ["Read the present T7 through the ASMedia bridge after reconnect or recovery.", "Confirm no recurring stale-device alert while the T7 is present and healthy.", "Merge and deploy the source fix through the repository single writer.", "Verify smartd and Fedora System Monitor live after deployment."]
work_item_result_receipts.evidence_json: ["Commit 3d3ec7987fb4d730eedeae49a547e0e1919522a6; PR https://github.com/gernalix/fedora-system-monitor/pull/20 queued.", "11 targeted unittest cases pass; systemd-analyze verify, bash -n, and git diff --check pass.", "Current lsblk has no Samsung T7; /dev/disk/by-id/usb-Samsung_PSSD_T7_Shield_* is absent.", "smartd.service and fedora-system-monitor-events.service are active; installed smartd.conf still ignores the absent T7."]
work_item_result_receipts.blocker: Samsung T7 Shield is physically absent, so ASMedia SMART read, reconnect behavior, and post-deploy notification acceptance cannot be verified safely.
work_item_result_receipts.next_action: After PR #20 is merged and the T7 Shield is physically reconnected, deploy the monitor, read SMART with smartctl -d sntasmedia on the verified by-id path, and verify smartd/Fedora System Monitor logs without recurring stale-device alerts.
